title: Broken Access Control
description: Broken access control allows users to act outside their intended permissions, including accessing another user's records or invoking restricted operations.
indicators: authorization missing on a route or operation
record access relies only on a client-supplied identifier
role or ownership checks performed only in client code
prevention: Deny by default and enforce authorization in trusted server-side code.
Check the caller's permission and ownership for every protected object and operation.
Reuse centralized access-control checks and test both allowed and denied cases.
source: OWASP Top 10:2025 A01 Broken Access Control (https://top10.owasp.org/2025/A01_2025-Broken_Access_Control/); MITRE CWE-862 (https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/862.html)
